objects.description: [Mini Shai-Hulud](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9043) has evaded execution in virtual environments and sandboxes through checking system information to include the number of CPUs and exiting at times when there were less than four and other times when there were less than two CPUs.(Citation: Wiz Mini Shai-Hulud MAY 2026)(Citation: Hunt.io TeamPCP Toolkit MAY 2026)(Citation: Phoenix TeamPCP 20 MAY 2026)
